title: Shut Down (League of Legends)
blurb: Nothing in League of Legends tastes sweeter than ending somebody's killing spree and pocketing the gold they had been accumulating for it. The announcer calls "Shut down!" and the bounty transfers, which is both a mechanical rubber band and a small public humiliation. Riot leans into it. The line has long since escaped the game and now shows up wherever a winning streak collapses in front of an audience, sporting or otherwise. Two words, perfectly weighted, and useful in almost any argument you happen to be winning.
origin: The announcer's 'Shut down!' call from League of Legends.
